g.text: positive amount <= order total and remaining payment balance,
and a nonblank reason. They set the target Order=CANCELLED.
Full refund refunds the remaining amount and cancels
without an external payment gateway integration.
SubOrderService also derives group refund status from
cancelled order counts; it can differ from monetary status
if direct Admin partial refunds use arbitrary amounts.
releases stock and cancels all sub-orders.
Orchestration success has the same pending guards and publishes
initiatePayment rejects SUCCESS and refunded states.
Callbacks reject refunded states and attempts to fail SUCCESS.
Frontend payment proxy requires all sub-orders pending
and both group and payment PENDING before simulation.
Group-only cancellation does not change Payment status.
